## Verification

List checks performed and their results. Include relevant platform or manual checks and any validation that remains unavailable.

## Pack API and security boundary

State whether this changes Pack APIs, permissions, IPC, provenance, sandboxing, or other trust boundaries. For affected changes, link the design discussion and complete the relevant parts of the [Pack review checklist](https://github.com/sktkkoo/Yorishiro/blob/main/docs/contributor-review.md#pack-api-and-security-checklist). Otherwise write “No boundary impact.”
